_description: Lightweight memory store for the DesignOps Triage Agent. Updated after each run.

designer_fields.name: string
designer_fields.skills: array of strings: UX | VD | UX/R | MM
designer_fields.domains: array of domain/sponsor names this designer has worked with
designer_fields.embed_eligible: boolean — can this designer embed with a product team?
designer_fields.available_pct_next_4_weeks: array[4] of floats — fractional FTE available each week (0.0–1.0)
designer_fields.active_assignments: array of Jira keys currently staffed
designer_fields.past_assignments: array of Jira keys historically completed
designer_fields.notes: string — free text notes for the Iteration Manager

request_history_fields.days_to_staff: integer — business days from Added to Staffed date

run_log_fields.gate_decision: APPROVED FOR ASSIGNMENT | NEEDS INFO | ON HOLD | null
